references.text: Same wording regarding the burnt offering, a fire offering with a pleasing aroma to the Lord, with bulls, rams, and lambs.
Parallel text about the burnt offering with a pleasing aroma, mentioning bulls, rams, and seven-year-old lambs.
Similar list of offerings for the new moon day with one bull, one ram, and seven year-old lambs without defect.
Same offering formula for the Day of Atonement with one bull, one ram, and seven year-old lambs.
Basic instruction regarding burnt offerings from cattle that must be without defect.
Description of the burnt offering as a fire offering with a pleasing aroma to the Lord.
Reference to the eighth day of the Feast of Tabernacles with a fire offering for the Lord, same festival context.
Burnt offering with a pleasing aroma, a fire offering for the Lord - the same terminology is used.
First use of the expression 'pleasing aroma' in connection with Noah's offering to the Lord.
